**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

A blue illustrated wave and large NIGHT TIDE lettering fill an off-white poster. The saved WebP is 768 × 1024. The source notes that the requested middle dot was rendered as a larger bullet, so this is not described as exact character-level compliance. The image is attributed to zzo.ai’s first high-quality Flare run, not to the authors of an adapted prompt. No image input was identified and the generation was not reproduced. Offline recovery review on 2026-11-08 rechecked retained source evidence and original file integrity. Current source availability, animation playback and model execution were not tested.
